339-677-6968-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-6968-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4289-4770-5301-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7782.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-7286.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5231-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5231-5632.description:
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2685-2919-3263-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-2919-3263-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

662-1978-7704.description:
Cause Doc Samson to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat from step 2.

457-3525-3711.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

4004-4865-7149.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vesuvan Shapeshifter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Vesuvan Shapeshifter from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

813-3617-7339.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2279-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1334-1517-2034-7258.easyPrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture's third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1334-1517-2034-7258.description:
Cast Seasonal Ritual either from your hand or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {G}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Seasonal Ritual.
Resolve both Seasonal Rituals, adding {G}{G} and then exiling the original Seasonal ritual with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Rosethorn Acolyte from exile by paying {2}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rosethorn Acolyte.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-7175.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

3490-5295-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5295-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

38-2932-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
38-2932-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
38-2932-5220-6900.notes: You can sacrifice Skirk Prospector as the mana value 1 creature, if desired.

1818-4050-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-4050-5010-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1060-4083-4090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Sun-Crowned Hunters is indestructible.
1060-4083-4090.description:
Deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Sun-Crowned Hunters and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5687-5691-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

2558-2921-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-2921-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Bartolomé del Presidio to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3062-3484-5391-6753.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3062-3484-5391-6753.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

586-5256-5258-5618-6556.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3000-5670-5789.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-5789.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1398-2136.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
1398-2136.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Fanatic of Mogis.
Each Fanatic of Mogis enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage equal to your devotion to red to each opponent.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.

38-659-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-4068.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

539-1242-3467.notablePrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
539-1242-3467.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, adding {G}.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving Cinderhaze Wretch +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1325-2074-4050-4417.notablePrerequisites: Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1325-2074-4050-4417.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vorapede, adding {1}.
Vorapede dies, triggering itself and Kheru Bloodsucker.
Resolve the Vorapede trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}, two life and removing the +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2744-3575.notablePrerequisites: An additional creature with flying and indestructible on the battlefield.
2744-3575.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes' ability by sacrificing itself to deal 4 damage to the creature with flying and indestructible.
Aerie Ouphes's Persist ability triggers, returning Aerie Ouphes from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on all creatures you control.
The -1/-1 counter and +1/+1 counter on Aerie Ouphes are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat.

360-1071-1981-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
360-1071-1981-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden fifty times, gaining you 100 life.
Repeat.

1322-3982-4377-5131.notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1322-3982-4377-5131.description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Walk the Aeons from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1548-4897-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1548-4897-5147.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Port Razer, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

856-3582-3765.description:
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability, putting a ghostform counter on Cauldron Familiar.
Cast Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cauldron Familiar triggers, returning itself from exile to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Cast Cauldron Familiar.
Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, losing each opponent 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

193-1180-2369.notablePrerequisites: Aminatou has at least three loyalty counters.
193-1180-2369.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking target land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding mana that land could produce.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas.
Activate Nicol Bolas's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, drawing a card and causing each opponent to exile card from their hand or permanent they control.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Repeat.
